title: Check: Planning the Data Link Layer

questions.prompt: A new office is choosing between hubs and switches for its LAN. What should it pick, and why?
options: Switches: every port gets its own collision domain, and frames go only where they need to

questions.prompt: The office needs visitors to get internet access without reaching internal servers. What's the layer 2 answer?
options: Put guests on their own VLAN (and guest WiFi network), with a router or firewall limiting it to the internet

questions.prompt: If two switches are connected by two cables for redundancy, the network needs STP or RSTP.
Why do most organizations use VLANs rather than separate physical LANs for each group?
options: VLANs are more secure than physical separation
VLANs are cheaper and flexible: moving a user is a configuration change, not re-cabling

questions.prompt: What protocol tags frames with a VLAN ID on the links between switches? (802.1 and a letter)
Ceiling-mounted access points have no power outlets nearby. What's the usual solution?
options: Power over Ethernet from the switch

questions.prompt: Which is the best reason to choose wired over wireless for the servers?
options: Wired is cheaper to install everywhere
Wired is faster, more reliable, and harder to reach from outside the building

questions.prompt: A bridge is the better choice over a switch for a new 48-desk floor.
